final_adjustments.rationale: Chosen vlm_177558 K=+2.60 @ I=0.0 M is flagged mad_outlier (0.70 above sibling median +1.90, MAD=0.20). The closer-in-ionic-strength K-siblings vlm_177553=+1.70 (I=0.5), vlm_177554=+1.70 (I=1.0), vlm_177555=+1.90 (I=2.0) cluster near +1.70-1.90; request I=0.1 M sits between the I=0 outlier (+2.60) and I=0.5 (+1.70). Using the 6-K-sibling median +2.05 as a robust central value that avoids the I=0 outlier while acknowledging the upward trend seen at very low I.

examined vlm_170935 K=-10.200 at I=0.0 M is sign-discordant vs sole K-sibling vlm_170934=+12.200 at I=3.0 M for equation [M]+[L]^2<=>[ML2] (Cd+2Cl<=>CdCl2). A negative logK for a cumulative formation constant is chemically implausible for Cd(II) chloro-complex formation, whereas positive log beta2 values are consistent with the ML3 (beta872, +13.9) and ML4 (beta894, +15.5) siblings in the same network. Patching to +12.200 (vlm_170934) — the only chemically sensible K-sibling — even though it is at I=3.0 M.
